comment: The distinction between mediation as a role and topology as an arrangement is valuable. However, routing, transformation, authentication, orchestration, and audit are grouped together as if they always form one mediation role. These may have different authorities, locations, and risk profiles.

public.text: The distinction between mediation as a role and topology as an arrangement is valuable. However, routing, transformation, authentication, orchestration, and audit are grouped together as if they always form one mediation role. These may have different authorities, locations, and risk profiles.
public.suggestedRevision: Decompose mediation into distinct capabilities and state that each may be realised centrally, locally, at gateways, at endpoints, or through shared services.
